naziv: Vinarija MCC - Vino i vinogradarstvo
Lady of Wine - MCC vina: Organska i biodinamička
Biznis iz drugačijeg ugla | MCC organska vina i lepote Smederevske tvrđave
maliOpis: U novoj epizodi emisije Biznis iz drugačijeg ugla upoznajte inspirativne priče koje spajaju tradiciju, turizam i preduzetništvo.
opis1: Gost emisije je MCC vinarija sa Fruške gore, poznata po proizvodnji organskih i biodinamičkih vina nastalih u skladu sa prirodom i održivim principima proizvodnje. naziv: Wine Vision by Open Balkan: Vinsko oranje balkanskog teroara
naziv_en: Love, Nature and Wine: The Organic Story of McC Vineyards from Fruška Gora
maliOpis: Oduševljenje čitavim događajem potvrdila je i MW Karolin Gilbi (Caroline Gilby), jedan od vodećih svetskih stručnjaka za vino, predsednica žirija sve popularnijeg beogradskog nadmetanja ali i grupacije sudija određenih za vina Balkana na najvažnijem svetskom vinskom takmičenju Decanter u Londonu.
maliOpis_en: On the slopes of Fruška Gora in Erdevik, Don McCulloch and Seka Nikolić craft wines using organic and biodynamic principles, relying on nature and traditional production methods. Their philosophy prioritizes quality over quantity, without chemicals or artificial additives.
opis1: Naša Mcc Organska vinarija je osvojila 5 medalja.
opis1_en: McC Winery was born from a love of wine, nature and a quieter life; the vineyards were planted only after years of restoring the soil from chemical residues. They draw inspiration from Fruška Gora's long winemaking history—vines have been grown there since Roman times. Today their wines reflect authentic terroir, sustainable practices, and the personal story of an international couple who found their home in Srem.

naziv: Najbolja vina Srbije 2022: Novi vinski poredak
naziv_en: Best Wines of Serbia 2022: A New Wine Ranking
maliOpis: Dešavanja na vinskoj sceni Srbije poslednjih 12 meseci pokazuju da su turbulentne promene koje su obeležile njen uspon poslednjih godina sada ustupile mesto konsolidaciji postignutih rezultata.
maliOpis_en: Events on the Serbian wine scene in the last 12 months show that the turbulent changes that marked its rise in recent years have now given way to the consolidation of achieved results.
opis1: A lovely blog with great tasting notes about McCulloch Wine Merlot-Malbec 2012. Thank you Perica S. Radović, glad you enjoyed!
opis1_en: A lovely blog with great tasting notes about McCulloch Wine Merlot-Malbec 2012. Thank you Perica S. Radović, glad you enjoyed!
opis2: To važi i za vinarije i vinare, ali i trgovce vinima, vinske manifestacije, vinske medije, pa i publiku koja je dostigla zavidnu zrelost. Metaforično rečeno, vinska revolucija je završena, a ovo što sada vidimo obrisi su novog vinskog poretka u Srbiji. Ono što je do juče bila novost, postalo je sada novi standard, a novi akteri izrasli su u mnogim segmentima u nove lidere.
opis2_en: This applies to wineries and winemakers, but also wine merchants, wine events, wine media, and the audience which has reached enviable maturity. Metaphorically speaking, the wine revolution is over, and what we now see are the outlines of a new wine order in Serbia. What was a novelty yesterday has now become the new standard, and new players have emerged as new leaders in many segments.

naziv: Osvojili 5 medalja na Wine Vision by Open Balkan
naziv_en: We Won 5 Medals at Wine Vision by Open Balkan
maliOpis: McC Vinarija osvojila je 5 medalja. U kategoriji belo vino: srebro za Rajnski Riesling 2017 i Rajnski Riesling 2020, bronza za Traminac 2019. U kategoriji crveno vino: srebra za Merlot Malbec 2017 i Coupage 2018.
maliOpis_en: McC Winery won 5 medals. In the white wine category: silver for Rhine Riesling 2017 and Rhine Riesling 2020, bronze for Traminer 2019. In the red wine category: silvers for Merlot Malbec 2017 and Coupage 2018.
opis1: 01-04.09. organizovan je prvi međunarodni sajam vina u Beogradu, baš u vreme dešavanja najvažnijih ekonomskih i društvenih inicijativa povezivanja zemalja Zapadnog Balkana - Otvoreni Balkan između zemalja Srbije, Severne Makedonije i Albanije. Na sajmu je predstavljeno 330 izlagača iz 22 zemlje, dok je predstavnika iz vinskog sveta bilo preko 40.
opis1_en: From September 1 to 4, the first international wine fair was organized in Belgrade, right during the most important economic and social initiatives to connect the countries of the Western Balkans - Open Balkan between Serbia, North Macedonia and Albania. 330 exhibitors from 22 countries were presented at the fair, while there were over 40 representatives from the wine world.
opis2: Tokom sajma je organizovano i ocenjivanje vina Open Balkan Wine Trophy, a žirijem je predsedavala Caroline Gilby MW, dugogodišnja predsednica panela za Balkan na Decanter WWA ocenjivanju u Londonu, autorka brojnih knjiga o vinu i ekspert za vina Srednje i Jugoistočne Evrope. Žiri je proglasio najbolje ocenjena vina u različitim kategorijama.
opis2_en: During the fair, the Open Balkan Wine Trophy wine competition was also held, chaired by Caroline Gilby MW, long-time chair of the Balkan panel at the Decanter WWA tasting in London, author of many wine books and an expert in Central and Southeast European wines. The jury announced the highest-rated wines in various categories.
opis3: McC Vinarija osvojila je 5 medalja. U kategoriji belo vino: srebro za Rajnski Riesling 2017 i Rajnski Riesling 2020, bronza za Traminac 2019. U kategoriji crveno vino: srebra za Merlot Malbec 2017 i Coupage 2018.
opis3_en: McC Winery won 5 medals. In the white wine category: silver for Rhine Riesling 2017 and Rhine Riesling 2020, bronze for Traminer 2019. In the red wine category: silvers for Merlot Malbec 2017 and Coupage 2018.

naziv: Top 50 vina Fruške Gore 2023
maliOpis: Zlatnu oznaku TOP 50 dodelio je posebno istaknutim vinima sa Fruške gore stručni žiri na ocenjivanju u okviru manifestacije Fruška gora Wine Show, održane u Vili Stanković 9. septembra 2023. godine u Čortanovcima.
maliOpis_en: The TOP 50 label was awarded by a professional jury to specially distinguished wines from Fruška Gora at the evaluation within the Fruška Gora Wine Show, held at Villa Stanković on September 9, 2023 in Čortanovci.
opis1: Pravo je uživanje u letnje popodne boraviti u ekskluzivnoj vili Pokrajinske Vlade Vojvodine, uz vrhunsku gastronomiju i sve bolja fruškogorska vina. Možda najbolja u Srbiji, kako je otvarajući manifestaciju Fruška gora Wine Show napomenuo Igor Mirović,  prvi čovek Vojvodine, a nakon što je profesor Vladimir Puškaš pročitao imena laureata i svih 50 nagrađenih etiketa.
opis1_en: It is a real pleasure to spend a summer afternoon in the exclusive villa of the Provincial Government of Vojvodina, with top gastronomy and ever better Fruška Gora wines. Perhaps the best in Serbia, as Igor Mirović, the head of Vojvodina, noted when opening the Fruška Gora Wine Show, after Professor Vladimir Puškaš read the names of the laureates and all 50 awarded labels.
opis2: Proglašenje šampiona na velikoj bini legendarne Hale 1, gde su uglavnom stacionirane najveće ili najznačajnije vinarije Balkana, otvorio je Igor Luković, direktor ocenjivanja OB Wine Trophy čitajući poruku neke važne face iz globalnog vinskog sveta. Ta poruka govori o vinima Balkana kao jedne od retkih regija na svetu gde na relativno malom prostoru imate i ravnicu, planinu, more, reke.
opis2_en: The announcement of the champion on the large stage of legendary Hall 1, where the largest or most significant wineries of the Balkans are mostly stationed, was opened by Igor Luković, director of evaluation of OB Wine Trophy, reading a message from an important figure in the global wine world. That message speaks of Balkan wines as one of the rare regions in the world where you have plains, mountains, sea, and rivers in a relatively small area.
opis3: Toliki diverzitet teroara kakav gotovo ne možete naći na drugom mestu na Planeti, a gde vina ostavljaju degustatore bez daha što nisu potvrdila samo velika ocenjivanja poput Decantera, već i ovo u Beogradu na kome su peharnici ili somelijeri preko ruku preturili 3200 raznih etiketa puneći čaše masterima od vina i drugim vinskim sudijama.
opis3_en: Such terroir diversity as you can hardly find elsewhere on the planet, where wines leave tasters breathless — this was confirmed not only by major evaluations like Decanter, but also by this one in Belgrade where cupbearers or sommeliers handled over 3,200 different labels, filling glasses for wine masters and other wine judges.
opis4: McC: Coupage 2018, Cabernet Sauvignon/Cabernet Franc 2018, Coupage 2017
opis4_en: McC: Coupage 2018, Cabernet Sauvignon/Cabernet Franc 2018, Coupage 2017

naziv: Trofeji i velika zlata za srpska vina
naziv_en: Trophies and Major Golds for Serbian Wines
maliOpis: Naša MCC Vinarija osvojila je na ovom takmičenju 4 medalje!! Zlato su osvojili: MCC Kupaža 2018 u kategoriji crvena mirna vina od internacionalnih nearomatičnih sorti i MCC Rajnski Rizling 2017 u kategoriji bela mirna vina od internacionalnih nearomatičnih sorti.
maliOpis_en: Our MCC Winery won 4 medals at this competition!! Gold was won by MCC Coupage 2018 in the still red wine category from international non-aromatic varieties and MCC Rhine Riesling 2017 in the still white wine category from international non-aromatic varieties.
opis1: Nakon više odlaganja zbog nepovoljne epidemiološke situacije, 17. i 18. maja održano je Veliko ocenjivanje vina Srbije, nadmetanje koje je premijeru imalo prošle godine na Dan Svetog Trifuna. Događaj koji je organizovao Savez vinara i vinogradara Srbije održan je u hotelu Radisson Collection, a na njemu su najeminentniji vinski stručnjaci u zemlji dali svoj sud o vinima iz cele države.
opis1_en: After several postponements due to the unfavorable epidemiological situation, the Great Wine Evaluation of Serbia was held on May 17 and 18, a competition that premiered last year on Saint Tryphon's Day. The event, organized by the Association of Winemakers and Vintners of Serbia, was held at the Radisson Collection hotel, where the country's most eminent wine experts judged wines from across the country.
opis2: Vina su ocenjivana u četiri panela sa po šest sudija, a na takmičenje je prispelo gotovo 500 uzoraka vina iz svih vinskih regija Srbije. Svečano proglašenje pobednika po kategorijama, kao i dodela nagrada, bili su održani 22.maja u hotelu Radisson Blue. Premijerka Ana Brnabić obišla je sve štandove vinara koji su osvojili neku od medalja, posebno se oduševila pričom o MCC Vinariji i ljubavi između Dona McCullocha i Seke Nikolić i njihovoj viziji da naprave biodinamičko i organsko vino, jedno od najboljeg u Srbiji.
opis2_en: Wines were judged in four panels of six judges each, and almost 500 wine samples from all Serbian wine regions entered the competition. The ceremonial announcement of category winners and awards was held on May 22 at the Radisson Blu hotel. Prime Minister Ana Brnabić visited all the wineries' booths that won medals and was especially delighted by the story of MCC Winery and the love between Don McCulloch and Seka Nikolić and their vision of making biodynamic and organic wine, one of the best in Serbia.
opis: Naša MCC Vinarija osvojila je na ovom takmičenju 4 medalje!! Zlato su osvojili: MCC Kupaža 2018 u kategoriji crvena mirna vina od internacionalnih nearomatičnih sorti i MCC Rajnski Rizling 2017 u kategoriji bela mirna vina od internacionalnih nearomatičnih sorti. Srebro su osvojili: MCC Traminac 2018 u kategoriji bela mirna vina od internacionalnih aromatičnih sorti i MCC Merlo-Malbek 2017 u kategoriji crvena mirna vina od internacionalnih nearomatičnih sorti.
opis_en: Our MCC Winery won 4 medals at this competition!! Gold was won by MCC Coupage 2018 in the still red wine category from international non-aromatic varieties and MCC Rhine Riesling 2017 in the still white wine category from international non-aromatic varieties. Silver was won by MCC Traminer 2018 in the still white wine category from international aromatic varieties and MCC Merlot-Malbec 2017 in the still red wine category from international non-aromatic varieties.

naziv: Biodinamika u Srbiji
maliOpis: U članku ističe da je naš Traminac 2018 biodinamički adut Srbije, mlade vinarije MCC čiji je vlasnik Škotlanđanin Don McCulloch. Na njegovom vinogradu sprovedena su sva načela biodinamike, uključujući đubrenje iz kravljih rogova.
maliOpis_en: The article highlights that our Traminer 2018 is Serbia's biodynamic ace from the young MCC winery whose owner is Scotsman Don McCulloch. All biodynamic principles were applied in his vineyard, including fertilization using cow horns.
opis1: Viktor Čikeš, urednik magazina Vino.rs napisao je sjajan članak o biodinamici u Srbiji. U članku ističe da je naš Traminac 2018 biodinamički adut Srbije, mlade vinarije MCC čiji je vlasnik Škotlanđanin Don McCulloch.
opis1_en: Viktor Čikeš, editor of Vino.rs magazine, wrote a great article about biodynamics in Serbia. The article highlights that our Traminer 2018 is Serbia's biodynamic ace from the young MCC winery whose owner is Scotsman Don McCulloch.
opis2: Na njegovom vinogradu sprovedena su sva načela biodinamike, uključujući đubrenje iz kravljih rogova. Smatra da je ono što objedinjuje sve biodinamičke vinare je holistički pristup vinogradu kao složenom organizmu koji će biti zdrav samo ako je u potpunom skladu s prirodom.
opis2_en: On his vineyard, all principles of biodynamics were implemented, including fertilization with cow horns. He believes that what unites all biodynamic winemakers is a holistic approach to the vineyard as a complex organism that will only be healthy if it is in complete harmony with nature.

opis5: Sveti Trifun na Savskom Vencu koji je održan u Beogradu 13.02. koje je organizovao Savez Vinara i Vinogradara Srbije gde su članovi žirija (isključivo naši stručnjaci!) degustirali su 295 vina iz cele zemlje. Nakon pozdravne reči predsednice Vlade Srbije Ane Brnabić, vina su se ocenjivala u osam kategorija: najbolje crveno i belo vino od autohtonih sorti vinove loze, crveno i belo vino od internacionalnih sorti, roze, penušavo, dezertno i vino proizvedeno po tradicionalnom metodu.
opis5_en: Saint Tryphon on Savski Venac was held in Belgrade on February 13 and organized by the Association of Winemakers and Vintners of Serbia, where jury members (exclusively our experts!) tasted 295 wines from across the country. After opening remarks by Serbian Prime Minister Ana Brnabić, wines were evaluated in eight categories: best red and white wine from indigenous varieties, red and white wine from international varieties, rosé, sparkling, dessert, and wine made by the traditional method.
opis6: Osvojili smo bronzu za vino MCC Traminac 2017 u kategoriji tradicionalne proizvodnje vina, gde je ostvareno 86 poena i za Coupage 2017 - vino od internacionalnih sorti bronza sa ostvarenih 88.8 poena (delimo drugo mesto sa još jednom vinarijom po ostvarenim poenima).
opis6_en: We won bronze for MCC Traminer 2017 in the traditional wine production category, scoring 86 points, and for Coupage 2017 — an international variety red wine — bronze with 88.8 points (sharing second place with another winery by score).
opis7: Sa ovim rezultatima i bodovima definitivno smo na samom vrhu i jedna od najboljih vinarija u Srbiji.
opis7_en: With these results and points, we are definitely at the very top and one of the best wineries in Serbia.

naziv: Škotlanđanin među srpskom vinskom elitom
maliOpis: Na nedavno održanom ocenjivanju srpskih vina u organizaciji Saveza vinara i vinogradara Srbije, vinarija MCC iz okoline Erdevika postigla je zapažen uspeh osvojivši treće mesto za Coupage 2017 MCC
maliOpis_en: At the recent evaluation of Serbian wines organized by the Association of Winemakers and Vintners of Serbia, MCC Winery near Erdevik achieved notable success by taking third place for MCC Coupage 2017.
opis1: Na nedavno održanom ocenjivanju srpskih vina u organizaciji Saveza vinara i vinogradara Srbije, vinarija MCC iz okoline Erdevika postigla je zapažen uspeh osvojivši treće mesto za Coupage 2017 MCC u kategoriji crvenih vina od internacionalnih sorti i treće mesto za Traminac 2017 MCC u kategoriji vina proizvedenih tradicionalnom metodom.
opis1_en: At the recent evaluation of Serbian wines organized by the Association of Winemakers and Vintners of Serbia, MCC Winery near Erdevik achieved notable success by taking third place for MCC Coupage 2017 in the red wine category from international varieties and third place for MCC Traminer 2017 in the traditional wine category.
opis2: Ova mala vinarija koja proizvodi organska vina, doduše i dalje bez zvaničnog sertifikata, a koju je pre desetak godina pokrenuo Škotlanđanin Don McCulloch, prva je počela uspešno da primenjuje metode biodinamike u Srbiji. O tome svedoče sada već brojna priznanja, među kojima su i zlato za Coupage 2012 i srebro za godinu dana stariju berbu na Velikom testu Vino.rs 2014. godine.
opis2_en: This small organic winery — still without official certification — was started about ten years ago by Scotsman Don McCulloch and was the first to successfully apply biodynamic methods in Serbia. This is evidenced by numerous awards, including gold for Coupage 2012 and silver for the one-year-older vintage at the Vino.rs Grand Test in 2014.

naziv: Popodne jednog kabernea
maliOpis: Nakon mnogo godina provedenih u službi njenog veličanstva tokom kojih je englesku kraljevsku porodicu direktno čuvao, Škot Don McCulloch se zaljubio u jednu Sremicu i jednu Frušku goru donoseći vinske emocije i znanje iz dalekih, svežih i zelenih vinogorja Novog Zelanda i ugrađujući ga u biodinamički vinograd u Erdeviku.
maliOpis_en: After many years serving Her Majesty and directly guarding the English royal family, Scotsman Don McCulloch fell in love with a woman from Srem and Fruška Gora, bringing wine emotions and knowledge from the distant, fresh, green vineyards of New Zealand and embedding them into the biodynamic vineyard in Erdevik.
opis1: Nakon mnogo godina provedenih u službi njenog veličanstva tokom kojih je englesku kraljevsku porodicu direktno čuvao, Škot Don McCulloch se zaljubio u jednu Sremicu i jednu Frušku goru donoseći vinske emocije i znanje iz dalekih, svežih i zelenih vinogorja Novog Zelanda i ugrađujući ga u biodinamički vinograd u Erdeviku.
opis1_en: After many years serving Her Majesty and directly guarding the English royal family, Scotsman Don McCulloch fell in love with a woman from Srem and Fruška Gora, bringing wine emotions and knowledge from the distant, fresh, green vineyards of New Zealand and embedding them into the biodynamic vineyard in Erdevik.
opis2: Sublimat ovde izrečenog lako se uočava u crvenom vinu, kupaži dve sorte kabernea koje kao da je krajem proleća odjednom sazrelo i eksplodiralo svim svojim atributima. Kaberne fran je sve popularniji u Srbiji, pri čemu ova MCC etiketa dokazuje da je sposoban za vrhunske svetske izazove.
opis2_en: The sublime sentiment expressed here is easily noticeable in the red wine, a blend of two cabernet varieties that seemed to ripen all at once at the end of spring and explode with all their attributes. Cabernet Franc is becoming increasingly popular in Serbia, and this MCC label proves it is capable of top global challenges.

naziv: MCC MCCULLOCH WINES: ALL-NATURAL NECTAR OF THE GODS FROM FRUŠKA GORA
maliOpis: In vino veritas and the truth is that love is the key ingredient for a good wine and a good life. McCulloch couple – Englishman Don McCulloch and Serbian-born Seka Nikolić witness about the good life in Vojvodina where one girl's childhood memories live in every corner of Erdevik and the quiet life of Fruška Gora which gives a lot of good energy after intense working years.
opis1: In vino veritas and the truth is that love is the key ingredient for a good wine and a good life. McCulloch couple – Englishman Don McCulloch and Serbian-born Seka Nikolić witness about the good life in Vojvodina where one girl's childhood memories live in every corner of Erdevik and the quiet life of Fruška Gora which gives a lot of good energy after intense working years.
opis2: Don and Seka McCulloch welcomed our DC „dvojac bez kormilara“ offering us to sit in their UK-Yugoslavia beautiful house decorated with interesting details such as cow horns, shell shaped ornaments and Seka's paintings. Don tells us how MCC winery captivates holistic and "old world" methodologies to work with nature reminding us that the vines were grown in Fruška Gora as early as 296 AD and that modern viticulture was brought here by the Roman Emperor Probus. "Our wines are unique being completely organic and our maxima is 'quality is more important than quantity.' As a producer of food – and the wine is soul food – we have a huge responsibility to people who drink our wines not to put chemicals in our bottles. I have heard that as much as 125 mg of chemicals can be traced in a bottle of commercial wine now. When making wine, one has immense responsibility."

naziv: TASTE FROM RUSSIA
maliOpis: A lovely blog with great tasting notes about McCulloch Wine Merlot-Malbec 2012. Thank you Perica S. Radović, glad you enjoyed!

opis2: For full article click here > http://merlo.rs/mcculloch-wines-mcc-merlot-malbec-2012/
opis: Tasting notes translated to English > This wine is produced in a limited edition of 975 bottles. The color is beautiful, deep, almost purple. After an hour in the decanter, the nose, at first, surprising. A strange smell that, though, quickly passes, leaving behind quite a pleasant trace of ripe, sweet, crushed blackberries. Dense, powerful and unmolested smell. Alcohol is not too noticeable. Although very strong (15%), great hidden. Taste intense, fruity. Very friendly. Dominated by aromas of small red fruits. Tannins somewhat contentious, good acid. Balance slightly compromised in favor of tannin. And the subsequent intense taste, strong. Chocolate and fruity, with a touch of coffee. It takes a long time, leaves an impression of fullness in the mouth. At the very fringes, brings something spicy aromas. Alcohol noticeable in the mouth and stomach, rather than on the nose. I really like this wine. Unconventional, character. Sharp and smooth, seductive. Attracts attention. Somewhat surprising style of red wine of Fruška Gora. Are the glass behind it remains a very dirty, but it's worth. Excellent. Perica S. Radović
